content.text: WARNING: split cut nothing: no split point falls inside any of the clips. Positions are relative to each clip's start (1|1), and must be before its end; the clips span 558 (1|1 to 3|1).
WARNING: param "split" is deprecated and will be removed; use "arrangementSplit" instead. Positions are on the song timeline, not offsets from the clip's start.
